panels.title: Open issues (excl. PRs)
panels.description: Count of open issues only — pull_request rows are filtered out (GitHub /issues returns both). Source: Infinity datasource, GitHub search API.

panels.title: Resolver failures (24h)
panels.description: resolver_failed events in the last 24h. Source: agent_events.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS failures FROM agent_events WHERE event IN ('resolver_failed') AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch')
targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS failures FROM agent_events WHERE event IN ('resolver_failed') AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch')

panels.title: Resolver outcomes per day (7d)
panels.description: Daily resolver outcome trend: delivered vs failed (resolver_failed) vs awaiting-approval vs dirty-workspace. Shows whether the auto-resolver is shipping fixes or stalling. Source: agent_events resolver_* events.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date(ts)) AS INTEGER) AS time, SUM(event='resolver_delivered') AS delivered, SUM(event IN ('resolver_failed')) AS failed, SUM(event='resolver_awaiting_approval') AS awaiting, SUM(event='resolver_dirty_workspace') AS dirty_workspace FROM agent_events WHERE event LIKE 'resolver%' AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch') GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date(ts)) AS INTEGER) AS time, SUM(event='resolver_delivered') AS delivered, SUM(event IN ('resolver_failed')) AS failed, SUM(event='resolver_awaiting_approval') AS awaiting, SUM(event='resolver_dirty_workspace') AS dirty_workspace FROM agent_events WHERE event LIKE 'resolver%' AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch') GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Open GitHub issues (<your-org>/jarvis)
panels.description: Live via the Infinity datasource, authenticated with the M2-Mini fine-grained PAT (bearer token from .env). Includes PRs (GitHub /issues returns both).

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts, event, detail FROM agent_events WHERE event LIKE 'resolver%' AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 200
targets.queryText: SELECT ts, event, detail FROM agent_events WHERE event LIKE 'resolver%' AND julianday(ts) >= julianday($__from/1000,'unixepoch') AND julianday(ts) < julianday($__to/1000,'unixepoch') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 200
